run_pose_estimation: run pose estimation on RGB-D images using FoundationPose ZMQ socket to get object orientation and spinal axis
detect_orientation: detect whether an object is vertical or horizontal and compute signed angles from camera pose matrices
compute_signed_angle: compute the signed angle in degrees between two magnum Vector3 vectors using dot and cross products
use_OrientationSolver: use OrientationSolver to determine anchor object pose, target grasp quaternion, and correction angles for robot manipulation
perform_orientation_correction: perform orientation correction on a Spot robot gripper by computing and applying correction angles based on spinal axis
